same_witness: Actual Node DIGEST requests and Node/Value byte traffic use the same extracted vs/es. Parent and VPARENT balances are derived internally.
proved: Each revealed child prehash is SHA256 of its exact extracted serialization.
Every extracted node serialization consists of bytes below256.
Each revealed value prehash is SHA256 of the same es[id] bytes with exact natural length.
remaining: Unfolded semantic tree encoding and key lookup are not claimed by this package. Existing pure rootedDag3/enc_fullTree are next consumers.
